method.timing: Application firstFrameMs retains its original full-startup definition; compileMs includes warmup/render/queue completion
method.programs: renderer.info.memory.programs counts shader programs, not native GPU pipelines
method.limitations: Four interleaved loads are a diagnostic, not a cold-cache confidence interval
